_about: Timings judged by ear in the beat viewer. These are the only human labels in this folder; everything in output/ is machine-made. Times in seconds. An edge listed under 'timed' was given as a time by the listener. An edge listed under 'accepted' was a detector value the listener looked at and called right: weaker evidence, because the listener saw the value first. 'beat_present' lists stretches a detector doubted and the listener confirmed have a beat.
